name: Open ParaBank SAVINGS Account
description: Logs into ParaBank online banking with vault credentials (PARABANK_USERNAME / PARABANK_PASSWORD), opens a new SAVINGS account funded by the customer's default existing account (the minimum opening deposit is transferred from it), and returns `newAccountNumber` from the "Account Opened!" confirmation page. Because opening an account and moving the opening deposit cannot be undone, the submit step is marked irreversible and requires human approval on each replay. Business outcomes: LOGIN_REJECTED (credentials not verified) and ACCOUNT_NOT_OPENED (form re-shown with no confirmation, e.g. minimum deposit not covered).

newAccountNumber.description: The account number of the newly opened SAVINGS account.
